$note: Architect profile for RepoYeti. Run from the Connections checkout: ARCHITECT_NO_SELF_UPDATE=1 bun <Connections>/packages/connections-arkitect/bin/arkitect.mjs --root . --corpus <Connections>/.arkitect/your-checks --all. This repository is scanned as a FOREIGN root, so every check that declares a `homeBound` config key has that key emptied before the check runs (see packages/connections-arkitect/src/core/foreign-scan.mjs) unless THIS file supplies it - which is why `barrel-fanout-inventory` needs an explicit `policyPath` here rather than falling back to its own default. `.arkitect/` is gitignored in this repo (see .gitignore): this profile is local, not part of the checkout.

cloudfront-behavior-order.$reason: A key-name collision, not a CDN misconfiguration. This repository has no CloudFront, no CDK and no `aws-cdk-lib` anywhere (grep: zero hits for CfnDistribution or aws-cdk-lib in src/, tests/ or scripts/). `pathPattern` is RepoYeti's OWN field on an identity rule - see src/schemas.ts and src/identity.ts - and the one finding is in tests/identity-firewall.test.ts, where a wildcard rule is deliberately placed ABOVE an exact path to pin `matchIdentityRule`'s documented first-match-wins semantics. Reordering that array would invert the assertion the test exists to make. The check's engine matches any `pathPattern: "..."` string in any source file and its `roots` default (services/infra) is a foreign layout that the runner re-resolves onto this repo's own source roots, so narrowing roots cannot separate the two meanings either. RE-ENABLE THIS the moment `aws-cdk-lib` appears in package.json: then the collision becomes a real ambiguity worth reading.
